name: ahrefs/site-explorer-metrics-by-country
display_name: Ahrefs Site Explorer Metrics By Country
description: Split a target's organic and paid keywords and traffic by country.

date.description: Report date in YYYY-MM-DD format. Use today's date for current values.

limit.description: Maximum number of rows to return (1-50, default 10). Each returned row is charged, so this caps the cost of one call.

scope.description: Scope of the target: exact (this URL only), prefix (URLs starting with the target), domain (the domain without subdomains), or subdomains (default — the domain and all its subdomains).

target.description: The target of the report: a domain ('example.com') or a URL ('https://example.com/page').

protocol.description: Protocol of the target: both (default), http, or https.

pricing.note: Billed per call from metered usage; the reference price is typical.

readme:
# Ahrefs Site Explorer Metrics By Country

Split a target's organic and paid keywords and traffic by country.

## Pricing

- Inspect reference unit price: $0.014835 USD per result.
- Final settlement uses the provider-reported actual cost after strict validation; the reference price is not used to infer the final charge.
